a: Temperature relates to average kinetic energy of particles.
Latent heat is energy absorbed/released during phase change without temperature change.
Angle of incidence equals angle of reflection.
Refraction is the bending of waves when speed changes between media.
Doppler effect changes observed frequency when source/observer move.
Moving charges and currents produce magnetic fields.
Changing magnetic flux induces emf (Faraday's law).
Half-life is the time for half of a radioactive sample to decay.
Power is the rate of doing work: P = W/t.
Efficiency = useful output energy / input energy.
